annotations.title: Execute a signed Earn / move operation

description: Execute a prepared Earn / move operation with your signatures, one per step and in order (owner steps: base64 P-256 signature over payload_b64; trading_key steps: 0x… EIP-712 signature). All signatures are checked before the first step runs. Returns each step's result; status 'uncertain' means check get_earn before retrying. If this call times out, the operation may still be finishing: check list_operations ('executing' = still running; don't prepare it again until it ends).

operation_id.description: The operation_id returned by the prepare tool

owner_public_key.description: Your OWNER P-256 public key (SPKI PEM or base64). Required when the operation has Base transactions; every owner signature is then checked before anything is sent.

signatures.description: One signature per signatures_needed step, in order: base64 P-256 for owner steps, 0x… EIP-712 for trading_key steps

name: submit_operation
